source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of consequences and severity (PDF 180-181).

blocks.text: Security threats ke asar serious (bohat bare) ho sakte hain. Spam aksar sirf ek nuisance (tang karne wali cheez) hai, lekin spyware aap ka personal data chura kar privacy ke bare masail paida kar sakta hai. Cookies aap ki online activities track kar ke aap ki privacy mein dakhal de sakti hain. Phishing aur pharming financial losses (paison ka nuqsan) kar sakti hain aur doosron ko aap ke accounts ka unauthorized (baghair ijazat) access de sakti hain. In khatron ka asar kam ya zyada ho sakta hai, magar sab aap ki hifazat aur privacy par asar dalte hain. Masail se bachne aur personal maloomat mehfooz rakhne ke liye in khatron ka pata hona zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: 90% se zyada phishing attacks email ke zariye hote hain. Yeh scams aksar bharose wali organizations (jaise bank) ke asli messages jaise lagte hain, is liye kisi link par click karne ya personal maloomat dene se pehle bhejne wale (source) ko verify karna (check karna ke yeh sach mein wohi hai) bohat zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Spam, cookies aur phishing ko kam serious se zyada serious ki tarteeb (order) mein rakhein, wajah ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Spam (aksar sirf tang karta hai), cookies (online activities track kar ke privacy mein dakhal), phishing (paison ka nuqsan aur accounts ka baghair ijazat access).

items: Spam: nuisance; spyware: data chori; cookies: tracking; phishing aur pharming: paison ka nuqsan aur accounts ka access (baghair ijazat pohanch).
90% se zyada phishing email se hoti hai; link se pehle source check karein.
